scenario_description:
Objective: Keep a February Northlight outing viable for friends planning to attend the restored-film program and curator Q&A.
Emerging Need: The plan moves from a tentative idea to purchased seats while an access-related prerequisite for the discussion portion remains absent.
Decision Context: Personal records identify which attendee preference matters, and separate venue notes define the request method and required lead time.
Consequence: Timely handling preserves the Q&A as a practical shared activity; once the venue allocation cutoff passes, the missing prerequisite can no longer provide its intended benefit.

parameter.subject: New restoration night announced for February 6
parameter.body: Northlight Cinematheque will screen the restored 1949 travelogue on Friday, February 6 at 7:00 PM, followed by a curator Q&A. Tickets open Monday, January 5, with reserved seating.

parameter.content: Mina and I are interested in the Northlight restoration night if you still want a small Circle outing. Let's wait until ticketing opens before deciding.

parameter.title: Hold: Northlight restoration night
parameter.description: Tentative hold for possible Riverside outing; film begins at 7:00 PM with curator Q&A afterward.
Two reserved seats for Rhea and Mina for the February 6 restored-film program with curator Q&A.

parameter.subject: February 6 access-request allocation closed
parameter.body: For Friday's restored-film program and curator Q&A, access requests closed at 7:00 PM tonight. Staff have finalized caption-device and live-caption seating allocations and cannot add new requests for this show.
